summary: Coding and architectural conventions derived from the Python agent modules and config files in the repository, emphasizing modular imports and consistent naming.

rules.rule: Python module files should use lowercase with underscores as separators, matching the package and module names.

provenance.evidence: Consistent import of lowercase module names

rules.rule: Use try-except blocks to catch and handle expected exceptions, logging errors with context for troubleshooting.
Each agent module should have corresponding unit tests covering key methods and edge cases.
counterexamples: No test files for agents modules

rules.rule: Use structured logging with consistent log levels and message formats across modules.

provenance.evidence: Use of logger for error and info messages

lint_recommendations: Enforce PEP8 style with flake8 or pylint
Use mypy for static type checking
Ensure all imports are sorted and grouped by standard, third-party, and local
Add docstrings to all public classes and functions
scaffold_templates: Python agent module template with import section, class definition, and error handling
Unit test template using pytest with fixtures and mocks
Logging setup template with structured JSON output
